# The consulting income of
# usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account_then_income_in_canadian_dollars.txt edited
# with `--strategy update` into 1,000.00 USD paid into A, which owes 500.00,
# giving no guid.
#
# The first 500.00 repays what A owes, which draws down A's owed cost basis,
# and an edit runs none of the checks a disposal meets. So it is refused and
# sent to delete-and-import, as a new transaction giving no guid is refused.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
2034-02-01 * "Consulting income"
	guid: "0c0c0000000000000000000000000001"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD A 1000.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "1400.00"
	Income:Consulting -1400.00 CAD
